newsitem.title: USA: MedCare Technologies to enter Florida.
newsitem.headline: MedCare Technologies to enter Florida.

text.p: MedCare Technologies Inc said Thursday it will enter the Florida market by opening five centers next year to treat patients suffering from bladder control problems.

MedCare said the opening of the first center in Winter Park, Florida, in early 1997 marks the company's transition into a commercial vendor of its non-surgical medical protocol for treating bladder control problems.
MedCare offers non-invasive systems for the care and treatment of urinary incontinence.
Its stock was unchanged Thursday at 5-1/8.
